feature: Common shading dictionary cells and conditions (Table 77)
source_location: Directly inspected primary `doc/ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.pdf`: Table 77 starts on physical p.245 / printed p.230 and continues on physical p.246 / printed p.231; both printed footers were checked. Page 245 has 5 annotations, all `/Link` cross-references; page 246 has 7, all `/Link` references. No issue/StrikeOut/Caret alters Table 77. NOTE 2 says zero-height/zero-width BBox still paints one pixel and cites §10.7.4. NOTE 1 describes opaque imaging; Background is restricted to shading-pattern use, not direct `sh`.
errata: Direct primary annotation check: none of Table 77 page annotations on physical pp.245–246 is an issue correction; they are internal /Link references. The printed text in the held EC3 PDF is the effective source. No Table 77-specific issue was located in the errata index for this bounded pass.

cells.assertions: Existing public fixtures exercise Type 1–7, but this shard did not re-audit all selector rejection/recovery paths.

cells.condition: Required name or array; device, CIE-based, or special spaces are allowed except Pattern; interpolation behavior is further specified by §8.7.4.4.
cells.code: shading color-space resolution and conversion in pdf-colour; shading consumers in pdf-model
cells.assertions: Existing shading tests exercise device/CIE/Separation routes and function-based mesh cases. The Pattern prohibition is a producer constraint; no reader rejection is inferred.
cells.verdict: Selected routes covered elsewhere; not a whole-space certification.

cells.condition: Optional array with component count appropriate to ColorSpace. Used to fill portions outside shading bounds only for shading-pattern use; direct `sh` ignores it. NOTE 1 describes an opaque-model equivalent two-paint construction.
cells.assertions: `shadings.rs` tests pattern Background with/without entry for axial/radial/mesh/function cases and a separate direct-sh ignored-entry case. These are independent source-colored pixel checks.
cells.verdict: Supported for sampled routing; malformed component-count reporting is asserted separately.

cells.condition: Optional four-number rectangle in shading target coordinates; additional temporary clip on top of current/other clips. NOTE 2 explicitly preserves one-pixel painting for a zero-height or zero-width box.
cells.assertions: `shadings.rs::a_shadings_bbox_clips_what_it_paints` checks ordinary nondegenerate clip plus path intersection. No current public shading assertion was found for a zero-area BBox.
cells.verdict: Ordinary clip supported; zero-area Table 77 note is an assertion gap, not a confirmed implementation defect.

cells.condition: Optional boolean, default false; flag indicates filtering to prevent aliasing. NOTE 3 says sampling/output resolution and function smoothness determine artifacts, and filtering can be costly and unnecessary for smooth functions.
cells.assertions: No test was found that distinguishes AntiAlias false from true. The prose is qualified as a flag/indication and the note explains a performance tradeoff; this review does not treat absence of a pixel-difference test as a defect or prescribe an algorithm.
cells.verdict: Unresolved implementation/assertion scope; no failure claimed.

test_assertions: `shadings.rs::a_shadings_bbox_clips_what_it_paints` covers ordinary direct-sh clipping and path intersection. The added direct-sh zero-width/height draft passed on CPU and all three real Vulkan modes (parent run); it asserts a bounded nonempty line and distant transparency with ordinary red-BBox control. Its normal control samples x=30 inside [29,31]. The separate B20 tiling-cell test is not the Table 77 shading-BBox route.
verdict: SUPPORTED for sampled ordinary clipping and the direct-sh zero-width/height one-pixel BBox rule (parent reports CPU plus all three Vulkan modes PASS). This is not a whole-table/backend certification.
residuals: Pattern shading BBox and every backend are not established by this direct-sh test. AntiAlias true/false behavior remains uncharacterized. The direct-sh zero-area BBox rule is now execution-tested.

source_location: Directly inspected primary `doc/ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.pdf`: Table 79 header and rows on physical p.249 / printed p.234 (footer checked). The page has 2 annotations, both internal `/Link` cross-references to Tables 79 and 77; no EC3 issue annotation alters the rows. Coords is required [x0 y0 x1 y1]; coincident endpoints mean nothing is painted. Domain defaults [0,1]. Function is required, one-input/n-output or n one-input/one-output; each function domain must cover the shading Domain and output components are clamped. Extend defaults [false,false] with separate endpoint booleans.
errata: Direct primary check: physical p.249 contains only internal Link annotations, no correction annotation. No Table 79 issue was found in the effective errata index in this bounded pass.
ledger: §8.7.4.5.3, with common entries in §8.7.4.3; interpolation machinery also §7.10/§8.7.4.4.
test_assertions: Named public tests pin ordinary gradient endpoints/midpoint, perpendicular constancy, omitted default Domain/Extend, both asymmetric extension directions in `indirect_shading_values_spec_audit.rs`, nondefault Domain, BBox and direct/indirect array-member semantics. The coincident-endpoint no-paint clause is still a separate branch. `drafts/degenerate_type2_type3_geometry.rs` adds a public exact-xref no-paint case with a nondegenerate red-axis positive control; unrun.
verdict: Sampled Type 2 ordinary ramps, default values, both asymmetric extension directions, clipping, and common zero-area BBox behavior are supported. The coincident-axis branch has a targeted public draft but remains unrun.
residuals: Public coincident-endpoint case in `drafts/degenerate_type2_type3_geometry.rs` is not yet run. Function-domain superset/output-range behavior is not re-certified in this bounded pass.

feature: Type 3 radial dictionary cells and endpoint conditions (Table 80)
source_location: Directly inspected primary `doc/ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.pdf`: Table 80 begins on physical p.250 / printed p.235 and continues on physical p.251 / printed p.236 (both footers checked). Physical p.250 has 3 annotations, all `/Link` references to Figure 33 and Tables 80/77; p.251 has none. Table 80 says radii SHALL be nonnegative; one zero-radius circle is a point; both zero means nothing paints. Domain defaults [0,1], Function required, Extend defaults [false,false].
errata: Direct primary check: Table 80 span has only an internal /Link annotation on p.250 and none on p.251; no EC3 correction mark alters its cells. No related issue was located in the effective errata index in this bounded pass.
test_assertions: Public tests cover ordinary radial ramps, default non-extension, nested/cone backgrounds and both asymmetric Extend directions with nondefault Domain. Private `a_family_of_zero_radius_circles_paints_nothing` checks the solver with both extensions true, but does not exercise the public paint consumer. The new draft `drafts/degenerate_type2_type3_geometry.rs` adds both-zero public transparency plus a zero-to-positive-radius blue pixel control; unrun.
verdict: Ordinary radial family, extension, root selection and private both-zero solver evidence are present. The both-zero public paint rule has a discriminating exact-xref draft but remains unrun.
residuals: Public both-zero and one-zero-radius geometry draft is unrun. It also pins direct-sh Background ignored behavior through the contrasting color control. Radial Domain, asymmetric extension and BBox are already covered by named current tests.
